title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Charging the Premium of a Cover
content:
A cover of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` that is in force owes its premium, and the premium becomes a debt on the cover's account when it is charged. This reference covers that charge.

## What the charge settles

The sum charged is the premium the cover's tier produces for the cover as it stands in force. An active cover that shows no premium charge on its account owes that charge.

Excluded from this charge is the prepaid premium that the binding conditions demand of a cash-in-advance holder under a tier with compulsory prepayment.

## Capability of the tool

`charge_cover_premium_8ce00127` places the premium of a cover that has been bound on that cover's premium account. A call enters one premium charge, bearing today's date, among the cover's premium and settlement entries, and increases the cover's unpaid premium, shown as premium due, by the sum charged. No money changes hands and the cover's status stays as it was.

## Invocation

Unlocking and calling this tool are both done by the desk agent, since it is one of the agent's own tools.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cover_id` | the cover whose premium is being charged, from the cover lookup | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the premium charged | US dollars, zero or more, two decimals; kept rounded to the cent |

## Return

Once the charge is booked the tool gives back `status` "charged", `premium_event_id` naming the charge entry it created, `cover_id`, `amount_usd` as booked, and `premium_due_usd`, the premium left unpaid on the cover after the charge, in US dollars to two decimals. The holder can then hear the premium charged and the premium now outstanding.
